verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robotics simulator. Its documented introspection, CLI tools and socket-based Gazebo Transport all apply to simulations running on remote servers, not to inspecting live topics, logs and state on a deployed physical robot. Simulation-side introspection and the transport pub/sub library are adjacent capabilities and developer building blocks, so they earn no credit toward remote debugging of deployed robots.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can inspect live topics, logs, and state on a deployed robot remotely to debug issues
